description: This Java class implements an entity-tag according to RFC 7232, including validation, comparison, and string representation methods.

classes.name: EntityTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing an HTTP entity-tag with support for validation, comparison, and string conversion.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if a given CharSequence matches the entity-tag pattern with optional weak prefix.

methods.name: getOpaqueTag
methods.description: Returns the opaque tag string of the entity-tag.

methods.name: isWeak
methods.description: Indicates whether the entity-tag is weak.

methods.name: strongCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison between this entity-tag and another, following RFC 7232 rules.

methods.name: weakCompareTo
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison between this entity-tag and another.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag instance from its string representation, handling weak and strong tags.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Builds an EntityTag from a given entity object, returning an Optional.

methods.name: strong
methods.description: Creates a strong EntityTag with the specified opaque tag.

methods.name: weak
methods.description: Creates a weak EntityTag with the specified opaque tag.
